description.value: The Farmhouse is an intimate Italian restaurant housed in a restored heritage home in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, featuring a backyard patio and a short service bar overlooking the open kitchen. Its kitchen is stocked by local BC growers and foragers — notably Campagna Farm in Abbotsford — weaving West Coast seasonality into classic Italian antipasti, mains, and desserts. The restaurant is part of the Viaggio Hospitality group and offers brunch through late dinner service alongside a curated list of biodynamic and organic wines from BC and Italy.
